531. Board Game Navigation

Medium  Topics

Problem Statement:
Vasanth is playing a board game on a rectangular grid (matrix). Each cell of the matrix has a number, representing the "value" of that tile. The player can move only from left to right in the same row. When the player reaches the end of a row, they automatically move to the first cell of the next row (row + 1, column = 0). A move is valid only if the value of the next cell is strictly greater than the current cell. i.e., you can only step to a higher value. Diagonal or backward moves are not allowed. Determine if Vasanth’s piece can reach the bottom-right corner of the board starting from a given starting position (startRow, startCol).
input_spec: Dimensions of the matrix, elements of the matrix, followed by location of Vasanth’s piece [ i j ]
output_spec: yes if the piece can reach the rightmost lower corner, no if otherwise.
